jobs.name: momentum_03_momo_clip_a
jobs.prompt: The blue sphere mascot sits still beside the cream phone, then its thin antenna wiggles twice, the yellow bead bobbing. Its white oval eyes blink once. It rotates about ten degrees toward the phone on its right, like a stop-motion turn, holds a beat, and turns back to face camera. The phone stays still and blank. Camera locked. Soft top-left light fixed, the drop shadow shifting slightly with the turn. Mascot proportions, eye spacing and antenna length stay exactly constant. Ends in the starting pose. No text, no faces.

jobs.name: momentum_03_momo_clip_b
jobs.prompt: Camera locked. The blue sphere mascot leans slowly toward the cream phone on its right, antenna tilting with it, as if peering at the blank screen, and holds the lean. Its eyes stay open and fixed on the phone. The phone does not move and stays blank. Soft top-left light fixed, cream cardstock still. Mascot proportions stay exactly constant. Ends holding the lean, both in frame. No text, no faces.

jobs.name: momentum_03_momo_clip_c
jobs.prompt: The small blue sphere mascot sits alone on cream cardstock, still. The yellow bead on its antenna brightens briefly like a tiny light and bobs. The mascot does one small vertical hop, squashing slightly on landing, and settles. Then it tilts its whole body a few degrees to one side, curious, and returns upright. Camera locked. Soft top-left light fixed, soft drop shadow following the hop. Proportions stay exactly constant. Ends in the starting pose. No text, no faces.

jobs.name: momentum_04_bumper_clip_b
jobs.prompt: The flat blue disc mascot rests against the white cylinder, eyes open. It blinks once quickly, then rocks gently side to side about five degrees, the curly antenna swaying, and settles. It glances up and to the left, then back to camera. Camera locked. Light and shadow fixed, cylinder still. Ends in the starting pose. No text.

jobs.name: momentum_x1_momo_machine_clip
jobs.prompt: The blue sphere mascot looks up at the folded blue cardstock polyhedron beside it. The polyhedron slowly rotates a quarter turn on its base, gold beads catching the light, and settles. The mascot tilts its head, antenna bobbing with the yellow bead, then does one small excited hop and settles. Camera locked. Soft top-left light fixed, both shadows tracking. Cream cardstock still. Mascot proportions stay exactly constant. Ends with both at rest. No text, no faces.

jobs.name: momentum_x2_paper_city_clip
jobs.prompt: The folded blue cardstock museum stands still. The camera pushes in very slowly toward the roof, about fifteen percent over the shot, keeping the building centred. The small blue disc mascot on the roof blinks, then hops once and lands with a small wobble, its curly antenna bouncing, and looks toward camera. Soft studio key from the right fixed, long shadows steady. Cream cardstock sky still. Ends with the mascot at rest on the roof. No text, no faces, no people.

jobs.name: momentum_x7_bird_liftoff
jobs.prompt: A vintage sepia copperplate engraving of a songbird on a twig, printed on aged cream paper, lies flat under soft top-left light. The engraved bird holds still for a beat, then its head turns slightly, and its engraved wings begin to beat: the bird lifts off the page as a living engraving, still made entirely of sepia ink lines and stipple, rising up and to the right out of frame with real wingbeats, casting a soft shadow on the paper as it rises. Left behind on the paper is the faint pale ghost outline of where the bird was, and the twig. The paper itself never moves, the camera is locked, the light is fixed. Ends with the page empty except the twig and the faint outline. No text, no colour, no glow.

jobs.name: momentum_x8_scrapbook_opener_clip
jobs.prompt: Top-down on the layered scrapbook composition. The three torn paper sheets settle into place one after another as if just laid down, each landing with a soft paper flop and a tiny rotation. The washi tape strips press down and stick. The photo corners snap onto the small engraving. The brass brad drops in and the rusted paperclip slides on. Last, the folded blue cardstock triangle lands and rocks once to rest, its gold bead catching the light. Camera locked top-down, soft top-left light fixed, real shadows between the layers shifting as they settle. The upper left third stays empty cream. No hands, no text. Ends with everything still.

jobs.name: momentum_04_bumper_clip_a_v2
jobs.prompt: The flat blue disc mascot sleeps leaning against the white cylinder, eyes drawn closed. Its eyes pop open suddenly. It does one snappy hop to the left as a rigid disc, rocking and wobbling like a coin, head tilting, the curly antenna bouncing with secondary motion, then settles back against the cylinder with a dampened overshoot. Finally it blinks slowly back to a closed-eye smile, exactly as it began. The mascot is a disc with a face and an antenna and nothing else: no arms, no legs, no hands, no feet, no limbs ever appear at any moment. Camera completely locked. Soft key from the right fixed, shadow following the hop. The cylinder never moves. Ends in the identical sleeping pose. No text.

jobs.name: momentum_x5_particles_disperse
jobs.prompt: A dense circular ring of tiny glowing blue and gold particles hangs still in the dark. It holds for a beat, then the ring breaks apart from its centre outward, particles scattering in every direction with soft drift and depth, near ones passing large and soft, far ones sharp and small, thinning until only faint scattered specks remain drifting. Camera locked. No shapes, no letters, no logo, no light rays. Deep navy-black field throughout. Ends almost empty.

jobs.name: momentum_x6_particles_cream_converge
jobs.prompt: Thousands of tiny matte blue and gold paper specks lie scattered on cream cardstock. Over the shot they slide inward across the paper as if drawn by a magnet, gathering into a dense, perfectly circular ring at centre frame, each speck settling with a tiny bounce, the ring becoming denser and more defined as specks arrive. Soft top-left light fixed, tiny shadows tracking. Camera locked. No shapes, no letters, no logo. Cream paper throughout. Ends with the ring dense and still.
